filtered AS (
  SELECT player_id, is_home,
    CASE 
      WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 'home_win'
      WHEN home_team_goal < away_team_goal THEN 'away_win'
    END AS match_result
  FROM all_players
  WHERE home_team_goal != away_team_goal
),
player_stats AS (
  SELECT player_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (match_result = 'home_win' AND is_home = 1) OR (match_result = 'away_win' AND is_home = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS win_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (match_result = 'away_win' AND is_home = 1) OR (match_result = 'home_win' AND is_home = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_count
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY player_id
)
SELECT 'most_wins' AS category, p.player_name, CAST(ps.win_count AS INTEGER) AS count
FROM player_stats ps
JOIN Player p ON ps.player_id = p.player_api_id
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ps.win_count DESC) = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'most_losses' AS category, p.player_name, CAST(ps.loss_count AS INTEGER) AS count
FROM player_stats ps
JOIN Player p ON ps.player_id = p.player_api_id
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ps.loss_count DESC) = 1
